mapper.insert: INSERT INTO teams (name, description, owner_id, invite_code, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{ownerId}, #{inviteCode}, #{createdAt}, #{createdAt})
INSERT INTO team_members (team_id, user_id, role, joined_at) VALUES (#{teamId}, #{userId}, #{role}, #{joinedAt})
mapper.sql: id, name, description, owner_id, invite_code, created_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM teams WHERE id = #{teamId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM teams WHERE invite_code = #{inviteCode} FOR UPDATE
SELECT role FROM team_members WHERE team_id = #{teamId} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_members WHERE team_id = #{teamId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_members WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT m.user_id, u.nickname, u.level, m.role, m.joined_at FROM team_members m JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.team_id = #{teamId} ORDER BY (m.role = 'OWNER') DESC, m.joined_at ASC, m.user_id ASC

SELECT t.id, t.name, t.description, m.role AS my_role, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_members c WHERE c.team_id = t.id) AS member_count, o.nickname AS owner_nickname, m.joined_at FROM team_members m JOIN teams t ON t.id = m.team_id JOIN users o ON o.id = t.owner_id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY m.joined_at DESC, t.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE teams SET name = #{name}, description = #{description} WHERE id = #{teamId}
UPDATE teams SET invite_code = #{inviteCode} WHERE id = #{teamId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM team_members WHERE team_id = #{teamId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT a.user_id, a.status, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM quizzes z WHERE z.analysis_id = a.id) AS has_quiz FROM analyses a WHERE a.id = #{analysisId} AND a.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM team_analyses WHERE team_id = #{teamId} AND analysis_id = #{analysisId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO team_analyses (team_id, analysis_id, shared_at) VALUES (#{teamId}, #{analysisId}, #{sharedAt})
mapper.sql: SELECT a.id AS analysis_id, a.title, a.project_name, a.level, a.user_id AS shared_by_user_id, u.nickname AS shared_by_nickname, ta.shared_at, z.id AS quiz_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quiz_questions q WHERE q.quiz_id = z.id) AS question_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT qa.user_id) FROM quiz_attempts qa JOIN team_members tm ON tm.user_id = qa.user_id AND tm.team_id = ta.team_id WHERE qa.quiz_id = z.id) AS solved_member_count, my.id AS my_attempt_id, my.score AS my_score, my.total AS my_total, my.created_at AS my_created_at FROM team_analyses ta JOIN analyses a ON a.id = ta.analysis_id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN users u ON u.id = a.user_id LEFT JOIN quizzes z ON z.analysis_id = a.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT id, quiz_id, score, total, created_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY quiz_id ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC) AS rn FROM quiz_attempts WHERE user_id = #{userId} ) my ON my.quiz_id = z.id AND my.rn = 1
mapper.select: WHERE ta.team_id = #{teamId} ORDER BY ta.shared_at DESC, a.id DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM team_analyses WHERE team_id = #{teamId} AND analysis_id = #{analysisId}
mapper.select: SELECT q.id AS question_id, f.layer FROM quiz_questions q JOIN quizzes z ON z.id = q.quiz_id LEFT JOIN analysis_concepts ac ON ac.analysis_id = z.analysis_id AND ac.concept_id = q.concept_id LEFT JOIN analysis_files f ON f.id = ac.file_id WHERE q.quiz_id = #{quizId} ORDER BY q.id

SELECT la.user_id, la.id AS attempt_id, la.score, la.total, la.created_at, ans.question_id, ans.is_correct AS correct FROM ( SELECT qa.id, qa.user_id, qa.score, qa.total, qa.created_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY qa.user_id ORDER BY qa.created_at DESC, qa.id DESC) AS rn FROM quiz_attempts qa JOIN team_members tm ON tm.user_id = qa.user_id AND tm.team_id = #{teamId} WHERE qa.quiz_id = #{quizId} ) la LEFT JOIN quiz_answers ans ON ans.attempt_id = la.id WHERE la.rn = 1 ORDER BY la.user_id, ans.question_id
